question: What rational (1,2) relation yield follows from the qualified fixed rank-one nonisomorphic curve family under the complete ordered public-pair law?
family: base rational rank-one curve on all eight fields, plus post-screen proved rank-one nonbase curves (571,3) and (677,3)
query_law: all ordered (t1,t2) in [0,q)^2, R_i=Q-t_iG, Q=17G fixture
stopping_rule: complete census; retain each per-model status and all positive witnesses
accounting: charge every candidate model membership check, all admitted distinct rational relation tests and matched public-vector tests; retain prior 24 rank-screen and two generator-proof setup attempts separately
claim_boundary: retrospective finite-panel relation yield on qualified curves; public (1,2) test is directly available and no wall-time comparison is made
